about_the_game:
WildRise

When concrete crumbles, nature rises.

Centuries ago, when gray towers replaced ancient trees and concrete entombed the soil, a small guardian with large leaf-like ears named Floofi fell into a deep slumber. Now awakened to a world of stone and silence, Floofi senses the faint heartbeat of nature waiting beneath the surface—and needs your help to bring it back.

In WildRise, you'll journey alongside the forest guardian through the remnants of a forgotten world. Place mystical elements across barren landscapes to create patterns of renewal. Match glowing mushrooms, enchanted flowers, and magical seeds to crack through the concrete shell and release the vibrant life hiding underneath.

The Wilderness Awaits:

  • Transform cold stone into lush meadows with strategic tile placement

  • Harness special abilities like wildcards and clearing bombs to overcome obstacles

  • Witness the immediate visual transformation as greenery reclaims each area

  • Discover ancient monuments that hold secrets of the world before it changed

  • Follow Floofi's story through increasingly challenging puzzles and environments

Whether you're looking for a quick gaming break or hours of relaxing puzzle-solving, WildRise delivers satisfying gameplay with a meaningful purpose: restoring color and life to a world that's forgotten its roots.

No complicated rules—just your wits, a bit of strategy, and the pure satisfaction of watching nature break free with each puzzle you solve.

Will you answer the call?

short_description: Join Floofi, the forest guardian, on a mission to restore nature's splendor. Match colorful flora and fauna in this charming puzzle adventure to transform barren lands into flourishing wilderness. Will you help Floofi bring the world back to life?
